scripts.check:tooling: vp check --no-fmt scripts config tools vite.config.ts && tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @kairn/api-generation exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.api:generate: pnpm --filter @kairn/contracts run build:schema && pnpm --filter @kairn/api-generation run generate
scripts.api:check: pnpm --filter @kairn/contracts run build:schema && pnpm --filter @kairn/api-generation run check
scripts.check: pnpm build:server && pnpm build:worker && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:tooling && vp check --no-fmt apps/web apps/server apps/worker packages tests && vp run --filter "./packages/*" --filter @kairn/web --filter @kairn/server --filter @kairn/worker --fail-if-no-match --no-cache check && pnpm check:boundaries && node scripts/check-declarations.mjs && pnpm check:mobile
scripts.verify:shared: pnpm build:packages && pnpm check:boundaries && node scripts/check-declarations.mjs && node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && vp test run --config config/integration/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:data: pnpm build:worker && vp test run --config config/integration/vite.data.config.ts
scripts.check:mobile: pnpm build:packages && vp lint --config config/mobile-lint/vite.config.ts apps/mobile && pnpm --filter @kairn/mobile check
